title: November 9
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: On the day before she plans to leave for New York, Fallon meets Ben, an aspiring novelist. They agree to meet on the same date every year, and he'll write a story based on their lives.
readIf: you like a romance with a gimmick of yearly meet-ups, a slow reveal and a sweet ending.
skipIf: you dislike love stories built on heavy coincidence or big reveals.

pairings.reason: Another romance focused on a single couple and a love that persists over time.
A funnier, lighter romance about two writers learning from each other.
A bigger, stranger love story about meeting again and again across time.
